title: gh512_t010_regression_test TC-RG-02: lint_test_isolation.baseline.json has drifted to 117 issues, snapshot fixture still expects 115 (pre-existing on main, not caused by GH-649)
registered_by: ISSUE-FIXER (WF03-GH649-20260810 Step 1, GH-649/ISS-0645 triage, incidental discovery)
symptom: tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig TC-RG-02 compares tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json's `issues` array length against a fixed expectation of 115 recorded in tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json. The baseline currently has 117 entries -- a 2-entry drift.
confirmed_pre_existing: Verified via `git show HEAD:tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json` (HEAD at the start of WF03-GH649-20260810, commit a37cb79, before any change in this run) -- the baseline already had 117 issues at that point, so this drift predates GH-649/ISS-0645 entirely and is not something this run's migrations or test-file edits caused. GH-649 only edited the LINE NUMBERS of 4 pre-existing baseline entries (adp09/adp10 T010 findings whose lines shifted because of inserted session_replication_role-scoping code); it did not change the entry COUNT.
root_cause_not_yet_investigated: Some migration or lint run between GH-512's original close-out (which set the snapshot to 115) and the current HEAD added 2 net new suppressed findings to the baseline without updating tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json's total_issues expectation to match. Not yet identified which commit/PR introduced the drift -- needs `git log -p --follow tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json` bisection to find where the count crossed from 115 to 117.
acceptance_criteria: Identify which commit(s) added the 2 extra baseline entries

Determine whether those 2 entries are legitimate new T010/other findings that should be fixed (reducing the baseline back to 115) or are correctly-suppressed findings that make the snapshot's expectation stale (in which case update tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json's total_issues to 117 and document why in its own regeneration_note, per the existing convention in tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json's regeneration_note field)
zig build test-integration-gh512 (or the file's build step) exits 0
next_action: File as GitHub issue and add to global queue. Low severity (MINOR) -- this is a self-consistency check on the test-quality tooling itself, not a business-logic or infrastructure defect, and does not block any other test.
resolution: Bisected via `git log -p --follow tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json`: commit 28bf140 (WF03-GH375-20260809, PR #636, the ISS-0089/GH-338 sibling fix for env_test_root.zig/svc_test_root.zig's T050 false positives) added exactly 2 new baseline entries (T050, one each for tests/integration/env_test_root.zig:1 and tests/integration/svc_test_root.zig:1) -- both pure re-export aggregator files with no BPM_TEST_DB_URL reference of their own, correctly suppressed since their imported test files reference it individually. No other commit in the range altered the entry count. These are legitimate, correctly-suppressed findings, not new defects -- the snapshot was simply never updated after that PR landed. Updated tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json (bumped to snapshot_version 3): total_issues 115->117, by_severity.MAJOR 41->43, by_code.T050 22->24, with a snapshot_v3_addendum documenting the rationale and source commit. Verified: zig build test-integration-gh512 -- TC-RG-01/02/03 all PASS (TC-RG-02 explicitly confirms total=117, by_code={T010=74,T020=11,T030=6,T050=24,T060=2}, platform_admin=14). zig build exits 0.
